funds_data.description: The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. A significant portion of the index is represented by securities of companies in the financials and materials industries or sectors. Companies with economic exposure to and/or carry out the majority of their operations in Peru may include companies organized, listed, or with significant operations in developed countries. The fund is non-diversified.
